profile_name.description: Name of the profile for this copy operation.

source_server.description: Hostname or IP of the source IMAP server (typically localhost if using stunnel).

source_port.description: Port of the source IMAP service (typically stunnel port).

source_user.description: Username for the source IMAP account.

source_password.description: Password for the source IMAP account.

dest_server.description: Hostname or IP of the destination IMAP server.

dest_port.description: Port of the destination IMAP service.

dest_user.description: Username for the destination IMAP account.

dest_password.description: Password for the destination IMAP account.

folders.description: List of folder names to copy from source to destination.
